description.en-US:
This is the stable non-root patched-kushion build of KouPhotos.

Current patch bundle: De-Vanced (RookieEnough/De-Vanced)
Patch frontend: MorpheApp/morphe-desktop
Upstream package: com.google.android.apps.photos
Stable package identity: de.kwoo.shion.photos

The patch implementation may change in a later release without changing this package identity. Build configuration and APK provenance are published in the source repository.
